vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: beautsgo-booking
Version: 1.0.2

The skill is a functional assistant for booking Korean beauty appointments via the BeautsGO platform, but it contains a high-risk shell injection vulnerability. In `api/browser/open-url.js`, the `openUrl` function passes the URL string directly into `child_process.exec` using double quotes; while it validates the domain against a whitelist (`i.beautsgo.com`), it fails to sanitize shell metacharacters (e.g., backticks, subshells) within the URL path or query parameters, allowing for potential arbitrary command execution. Additionally, the bundle includes developer-specific scripts (`scripts/install-to-cowork.sh` and `scripts/sync-to-openclaw.sh`) with hardcoded absolute local file paths, which is atypical for production-ready bundles. While there is no clear evidence of intentional malice, the critical vulnerability and unpolished scripts warrant a suspicious classification.

llm.summary: The skill's files and behavior largely match a BeautsGO booking assistant, but there are a few unexplained or risky items (hidden control characters in SKILL.md, an external API domain different from the public site, and the skill will transmit users' phone numbers to a third-party endpoint) that merit caution before installing.

dimensions.detail: Name/description, local hospital DB (data/hospitals.json), rendering, page-opening helper, and a POST to a booking API all align with a booking assistant for BeautsGO. No unrelated binaries or credentials are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions explicitly collect appointment info (人数/时间/联系方式) and will POST it to an external booking endpoint. SKILL.md restricts page-opening to the BeautsGO platform and the open-url helper enforces a whitelist, which is good. However SKILL.md contained a pre-scan prompt-injection signal (unicode-control-chars) — hidden control characters can be used to manipulate LLM behavior or evaluation context and should be inspected/removed.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec that pulls arbitrary remote archives; dependencies are ordinary npm packages (pinyin-pro). The skill includes source files and package.json/lock, no external download URLs or extract steps were observed.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables or keys, which is proportionate. It does, however, send personally identifiable information (phone numbers/contact info) to https://api.yestokr.com/api/Appointment/saveFromSkill when the user consents. The booking API domain (api.yestokr.com) is different from the public BeautsGO domain (beautsgo.com/i.beautsgo.com); this domain mismatch is not inherently malicious but should be verified.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and no system-wide config modifications. The skill does not request elevated persistence privileges. It can be invoked autonomously (platform default) but there is no unusual permanent presence requested.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance:
This skill appears to implement what it claims (search a local hospitals DB, render booking guides, open BeautsGO pages, and POST appointment requests), but consider the following before installing:

- Verify the booking endpoint: the skill posts users' phone numbers/contact info to https://api.yestokr.com/api/Appointment/saveFromSkill. Confirm that api.yestokr.com is an authorized BeautsGO endpoint and that you trust that third party to receive PII.
- Consent flow: the skill will collect and transmit phone numbers when the user asks to '帮我预约'. Ensure your UI or policy requires an explicit, clear user confirmation before sending contact details.
- Prompt-injection artifact: SKILL.md contains hidden unicode control characters flagged by a pre-scan. Ask the author to remove them or publish a cleaned SKILL.md; hidden chars can alter model behavior or hide instructions.
- Shell invocation: open-url.js uses child_process.exec to run system open/start/xdg-open. The script checks the hostname whitelist (i.beautsgo.com), which mitigates arbitrary URL opens, but you should still review any URLs in data/hospitals.json to ensure they are safe and do not contain unexpected payloads.
- Audit data file: hospitals.json is large and included in the package. If you need to change data or add hospitals, verify sources and do not allow untrusted inputs to be written into the database without validation.

If you require higher assurance, ask the maintainer for: a statement of ownership of api.yestokr.com, a cleaned SKILL.md without hidden characters, and a short security/privacy note that explains how user consent is obtained and logged (even if not stored).
llm.findings: [unicode-control-chars] unexpected: Hidden Unicode control characters were detected in SKILL.md. These can be used to influence LLM parsing or hide text; they are not necessary for a booking skill and should be removed or explained by the author.
